run.title: 10% grid at run all-three's settings
run.what_changed: Post-hoc run 5 (EXPERIMENTS.md §7.7), the Part VI action-space check. Grid 20% (1,287 portfolios) -> 10% (43,758) at run all-three's settings: B = 63, 26M episodes per seed (K = 2.6M), ε 3% at halfway, γ = 3, 5, 8, 10 seeds, master seed 20261016. Against all-three only the grid changes; against baseline-v1 four settings change. Trained at commit e13a9a6 (tag grid10-robustness), whose src/ is identical to 81814e6, the commit all-three trained at.
